Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the target historian as Al-Ghazali. While the WebSurfer's search results clearly stated that Bousquet translated works by "Al-Ghazali, a theologian" AND "Tunisian historian Ibn Khaldun", the Planner misinterpreted the text, assuming Al-Ghazali was the historian in question. Al-Ghazali is primarily known as a theologian and philosopher, whereas Ibn Khaldun is explicitly described in the search results as a "Tunisian historian." Consequently, the Planner selected the wrong subject (Al-Ghazali, Persian) instead of the correct one (Ibn Khaldun, North African Arab), leading to the wrong final answer.
